author: RobDogs
body: Got banned for an entire month for swearing a few times, not to mention without any warning beforehand to stop. GuyNamedRiley did it.
body_tagged: Got banned for an entire month for swearing a few times, not to mention without any warning beforehand to stop. GuyNamedRiley did it.
title: month tempban

replies.author: GuyNamedRiley
replies.body:
Excessive infractions states that you have received a large surplus of infractions. Since you have over 10 in the last 8 months, you were temp banned based on the rules relating to these guidelines.

Please wait the allotted time for your punishment and we hope to see you back in game after the temporary ban is over.

Regards,
GuyNamedRiley || Avicus Moderator

replies.author: RobDogs
replies.body: Try warning said player that they are about to be banned for a month for swearing at someone targeting them please. I remember when this server wasn't worried about being politically correct and was worried about providing an enjoyable experience to players. It's true some of us swear a lot and I'm sure if I was warned I would be banned for thirty days for swearing I would have made an effort to not swear.

replies.body:
BloodyAustralian,
